Looking at this complex problem, I need to track the collection through multiple transformations carefully.

## Step 1: Initial Collection → After Cousin's Gift
Starting with 33 items, the cousin adds duplicates of items with smells of citrus fruits, coffee, or pine needles (giving them her favorite smell: lavender).
- Items added: duplicates of items 16 (Chinese bag), 21 (British stapler), 25 (German ball), and 29 (Canadian pen)
- New collection: 37 items

## Step 2: After Aunt's Replacement
Aunt replaces 7 extra-extra-large items (5, 17, 18, 21, 21new, 26, 30) with plastic versions having coconut smell.
- Collection remains: 37 items

## Step 3: After Dad's Removal
Dad threw away all items of one color. Comparing the given counts (37 items before, 36 after), gray was removed.
- Collection: 36 items

## Step 4: After Removing Even Item Types
Counting item types and removing those with even counts:
- Speakers: 2 items (remove)
- Scissors: 2 items (remove)
- Vases: 2 items (remove)
- Balls: 2 items (remove)
- Pens: 2 items (remove)
- Collection: 26 items

## Step 5: After Fiancée's Addition
Comparing (smell, color) pairs with initial collection, new pairs not in initial are:
- (coconut, brown) - item 5
- (coconut, khaki) - item 17  
- (coconut, red) - item 26
- (coconut, violet) - item 30

Fiancée adds copies of these 4 items.
- Collection: 30 items

## Step 6: After Losing One Extra-Extra-Large Item
One extra-extra-large item is lost. Since no items satisfying the conditions are extra-extra-large, this doesn't affect our count.
- Collection: 29 items

## Finding Items Meeting All Conditions

Now I count items where ALL five conditions hold:
- color ≠ pink
- size ≠ extra-extra-large
- material ≠ glass
- smell ≠ rose
- origin ≠ Spanish

Checking remaining items:

✓ Item 2: medium Portuguese stapler, ceramic, coconut - black
✓ Item 3: medium British flower pot, ceramic, garlic - black
✓ Item 13: small Afghan wallet, plastic, baking bread - indigo
✓ Item 14: extra-large Russian house, concrete, chocolate - indigo
✓ Item 16: medium Chinese bag, steel, citrus fruits - khaki
✓ Item 16new: medium Chinese bag, steel, citrus fruits - khaki
✓ Item 24: small Afghan candle, concrete, gasoline - purple

All other items fail at least one condition:
- Items with Spanish origin are removed
- Items with glass material are removed
- Items with rose smell are removed
- Items with pink color are removed
- Extra-extra-large items are removed

ANSWER: 7
